function.name: Utility_AdvanceEmbeddedWordPair
function.body: Loads two words from 0x001B32DE into D0/D1, adds D1.w to D0.w, adds D0.w plus the extend carry into D1.w, stores both words back to 0x001B32DE, and returns.
function.effect: Updates a two-word state pair in place according to the exact add/add-with-carry sequence.

data.name: EMBEDDED_WORD_PAIR_INITIAL_VALUE
data.effect: Provides the initial adjacent four-byte value consumed by the helper.

limitations: No runtime observation or direct static caller was recovered.
The helper's write target is within the cartridge ROM address range, so its effective statefulness is intentionally left unresolved.
conclusion: The 26-byte unknown gap is now partitioned into a 22-byte add-with-carry helper and its exact 0x31415926 adjacent value, using neutral names until reachability and memory-map behavior are established.
